quality_gate: Each cohort separately: raw/normalized/cpWER errors and native DER0 must not grow (DER floating arithmetic tolerance 1e-12), exact speaker counts must not decrease. Control threads2 must reproduce prior hypotheses and refined turns. No per-file parameters or tuning on holdout.
speed_scope: First complete quality passes are sequential but caches/order uncontrolled; no causal speed claim. Controlled reverse-order timing on same data is separate, as are Android 1/3/10-minute probes.
promotion: Only measured nonregressing thread variants may be accepted; ordinary builds and historical WorkData stay v16 until broader Android acceptance.
source_changes: Only explicit CPU execution policy permits 1/2/4; missing cpu_plan retains frozen two-thread host policy. Models, VAD, C2 thresholds/windows, decoder and ASR lexical settings unchanged.
